classDefinitions.name: Minor Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding nine calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding twelve calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Junior
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of six and not exceeding eighteen calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Special Long Coat Junior
classDefinitions.description: For Long Coat dogs of six and not exceeding eighteen calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Yearling
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of twelve and not exceeding twenty-four calendar months of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Novice
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won a First Prize at a Championship Show, in Novice or in a higher class, confined to Novice, Junior, Puppy or Minor Puppy Classes.

classDefinitions.name: Undergraduate
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won five or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Undergraduate or higher classes.

classDefinitions.name: Graduate
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won five or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Graduate, Post Graduate, Minor Limit, Mid Limit, Limit or Open Classes.

classDefinitions.name: Post Graduate
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won a Challenge Certificate/CACIB/CAC/Green Star or five or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Post Graduate, Minor Limit, Mid Limit, Limit and Open Classes, whether restricted or not, where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Minor Limit
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not become Show Champions and have not won ten or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Minor Limit, Mid Limit, Limit or Open Classes, whether restricted or not, where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Mid Limit
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not become Show Champions and have not won seven or more First Prizes at Championship Shows in Mid Limit, Limit or Open Classes, whether restricted or not, where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Limit
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not become Show Champions under Royal Kennel Club Regulations or under the rules of any governing body recognised by the Royal Kennel Club or won seven or more First Prizes in all at Championship Shows in Limit or Open Classes confined to the breed, whether restricted or not, at Shows where Challenge Certificates were offered for the breed.

classDefinitions.name: Open
classDefinitions.description: For all dogs of the breeds for which the class is provided and eligible for entry at the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Special Long Coat Open
classDefinitions.description: For all Long Coat dogs of the breed eligible for entry at the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Veteran
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of not less than seven years of age on the first day of the Show.

classDefinitions.name: Champion Stakes
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have become Show Champions or gained the title of Champion in the country of origin or residence.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Puppy
classDefinitions.description: For dogs eligible for entry in Special Award Classes, whether restricted or not. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Junior
classDefinitions.description: For dogs of eight and not exceeding eighteen calendar months of age on the first day of the Show. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Post Graduate
classDefinitions.description: For dogs which have not won a Challenge Certificate/CACIB/CAC/Green Star or five or more First Prizes at Championship Shows, whether restricted or not. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Special Award Class - Open
classDefinitions.description: For all dogs of the breed for which the class is provided and eligible for entry at the Show. They are not eligible for Challenge Certificates.

classDefinitions.name: Junior Handling
classDefinitions.description: Junior Handling Association class for handlers of six and not exceeding twenty-four years. JHA membership required.
